newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary BSE to list CA Devizakotveny fund on Nov 2.
newsitem.headline: Hungary BSE to list CA Devizakotveny fund on Nov 2.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) said on Monday that it had decided to list 105,971 units of CA Devizakotveny investment fund.
Trading in the units, each having a face value of 10,000 forints, would start on November 27 on the BSE, the bourse said in a statement in its official gazette.
The condition of the listing is that the investment fund manager pays the listing and trading fee to the bourse by 12 noon on the day prior to the listing, the BSE said.
